title: MY-Lang Full IDE
description: A fully functional browser-based IDE for MY-Lang — a custom-designed programming language — featuring a complete 5-stage compiler pipeline built entirely in JavaScript and React.
longDescription: MY-Lang Full IDE is one of the most technically ambitious projects you can build on the frontend: a custom programming language with its own compiler, running entirely in the browser with no backend. The language itself supports typed variables (number, text, boolean), arrays, if/else conditionals, while loops, arithmetic and logical operators, and single/multi-line comments. The compiler implements all five classical stages — Lexer (tokenization with line tracking and error recovery), Parser (recursive-descent producing a full AST), Semantic Analyzer (type checking, symbol table construction, and warning generation), Code Generator (emitting readable pseudo-assembly with labeled sections and HALT instructions), and Executor (AST-walking interpreter that runs the program and captures output). The IDE wraps this pipeline in a split-panel layout: a syntax-aware code editor on the left, and a six-tab diagnostics panel on the right exposing Tokens, Parser output, AST tree, Semantic analysis with a symbol table, Assembly view, and live Output. A step-through debugger mode lets users advance through each compiler stage individually, observing exactly what each pass produces. Eight built-in example programs — from Hello World to Bubble Sort and Fibonacci — let users explore the language immediately.
features: Custom-designed MY-Lang with typed variables, arrays, loops, conditionals, and logical operators
Full 5-stage compiler: Lexer → Parser → Semantic Analyzer → Code Generator → Executor
Recursive-descent parser producing a complete Abstract Syntax Tree
Semantic analysis with symbol table, type checking, and warning system
Pseudo-assembly code generation with labeled sections and HALT instructions
AST-walking interpreter that executes MY-Lang programs live in the browser
Step-through debugger mode to advance through compiler stages one at a time
Six-tab diagnostics panel: Tokens, Parser, AST, Semantic, Assembly, and Output
8 built-in example programs including FizzBuzz, Fibonacci, Bubble Sort, and more
challenges: Designing and implementing a complete compiler pipeline from scratch in pure JavaScript — writing a hand-rolled recursive-descent parser, a symbol-table-based semantic analyzer, and an AST-walking executor — then wiring all five stages into a reactive IDE with step-through debugging, all running entirely client-side with zero backend.

title: Career Expert System
description: A rule-based expert system that maps user skills to career paths using a forward-chaining inference engine, delivering ranked matches with confidence scores and skill gap analysis.
longDescription: The Career Expert System is a classic AI expert system built entirely in React, demonstrating how symbolic reasoning can be applied to career guidance. The knowledge base stores facts as typed triplets — has_skill and requires_skill relationships — modeled after Prolog-style logic. The forward-chaining inference engine evaluates each user's skills against every career's requirements in real time, computing a percentage confidence score, a ranked list of all career matches, matched strengths, and gaps to close. The dashboard features a two-panel Career Diagnostics view with a highlighted top recommendation card and a detailed ranked match table, alongside a dedicated Knowledge Base page that exposes the full fact database as an inspectable table — making the system's reasoning fully transparent. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
features: Forward-chaining inference engine that maps skills to careers in real time
Ranked career matches with percentage confidence scores
Matched strengths and skill gap breakdown per career
Highlighted top recommendation card with a progress bar
Inspectable Knowledge Base page exposing all facts as a structured table
Multi-user support with sidebar user selection
challenges: Implementing a forward-chaining inference engine in pure React using useMemo, so the reasoning reruns reactively on user selection without any backend — keeping the system transparent, fast, and fully client-side.

title: Personality Prediction Model
description: A full-stack NLP application that predicts Myers-Briggs (MBTI) personality types from free-form text input using machine learning and natural language processing.
longDescription: The Personality Prediction Model is an end-to-end NLP pipeline that classifies users into one of 16 MBTI personality types based on the way they write. The backend is a Flask API powered by a Logistic Regression model trained on a Kaggle MBTI dataset, with TF-IDF vectorization (5,000 features, bigrams) and an NLTK preprocessing pipeline covering lowercasing, URL removal, stopword filtering, and lemmatization. The React frontend features a dark-themed NLP Intelligence Dashboard where users type free-form text or pick from 20 curated example prompts, then receive an instant prediction with the MBTI type, archetype name, personality description, and model confidence score. The project covers the full ML lifecycle: data cleaning, feature engineering, model training, serialization with Pickle, and REST API serving with Flask-CORS.
features: Predicts all 16 MBTI personality types from free-form text
NLP preprocessing pipeline: lowercasing, URL removal, stopword filtering, and lemmatization
TF-IDF vectorization with bigram support (5,000 features)
Confidence score returned alongside type, archetype name, and description
20 curated example prompts for instant exploration
Dark-themed React dashboard with real-time API integration
challenges: Building a robust NLP preprocessing pipeline that removes MBTI-type leakage from training text, then bridging the Python ML backend and React frontend through a CORS-enabled REST API with clean, structured prediction responses.

title: Algorithm Visualizer
description: An interactive React application that animates fundamental search and graph traversal algorithms in real-time with dual visualization modes.
longDescription: The Search & Graph Algorithm Visualizer bridges the gap between theoretical code and visual execution by animating fundamental computer science algorithms in real-time. It features dual visualization modes—dynamic bar charts for Linear and Binary search, and a fully manipulatable grid for Breadth-First (BFS) and Depth-First (DFS) graph traversals—allowing users to intuitively explore algorithmic logic through custom data inputs, interactive wall drawing, and adjustable playback speeds. Built with responsive design principles and live complexity analytics, this tool serves as an educational sandbox for developers and students.
features: Linear and Binary search with bar chart visualization
BFS and DFS graph traversal on interactive grid
Custom data input and interactive wall drawing
challenges: Re-engineering standard algorithms to generate step-by-step animation sequences and translating them into smooth frame-by-frame visuals with live performance stats.

title: AlgoRhythm
description: A sorting algorithm visualizer that brings Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, and Quick Sort to life with frame-by-frame animation and real-time performance stats.
longDescription: AlgoRhythm re-engineers five classic sorting algorithms not just to sort, but to generate a step-by-step animation sequence of their logic. A custom visualization engine translates this sequence into a live, frame-by-frame animation, showing exactly how data is moved. The app provides real-time performance stats (comparisons, swaps, time) and interactive controls, demonstrating a practical mastery of algorithm analysis and dynamic state visualization.
features: Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, and Quick Sort
Custom visualization engine with frame-by-frame animation
Interactive controls for play, pause, and reset
challenges: Building a custom engine that converts algorithm logic into an animation sequence and rendering it smoothly without blocking the UI thread.

title: Xiaomi Giveaway
description: A high-performance full-stack web app for live-stage events allowing hundreds of attendees to register, receive unique entry codes via WhatsApp, and participate in a real-time animated Lucky Draw.
longDescription: Designed for live-stage events and inspired by the Xiaomi aesthetic, this platform lets hundreds of attendees register via their mobile devices and receive unique entry codes automatically via WhatsApp. The highlight is a cinematic, real-time Lucky Draw animation displayed on a main stage screen. Built with React on the frontend and Node.js/Express/MongoDB on the backend, with WhatsApp automation via whatsapp-web.js and live tunneling via ngrok.
features: Automated unique entry code delivery via WhatsApp
challenges: Handling hundreds of simultaneous registrations, automating WhatsApp messaging reliably, and delivering a smooth cinematic draw animation under live event pressure.

title: Medical Information Retrieval System
description: A medical search engine indexing 17,000+ PubMed papers using a Vector Space Model with TF-IDF and Cosine Similarity for sub-second retrieval.
longDescription: MedSearch is a medical search engine built with Python and Flask that indexes over 17,000 PubMed papers using a Vector Space Model. It features a full retrieval pipeline—from automated scraping to custom positional indexing—supporting Boolean logic and exact phrase matching. By utilizing TF-IDF and Cosine Similarity, MedSearch provides highly relevant research insights with sub-second retrieval speeds.
features: Boolean logic and exact phrase matching
challenges: Building an efficient custom positional index from scratch, automating large-scale scraping from PubMed, and tuning the ranking model for medical relevance.

title: WatchWise
description: A movie discovery app that helps users explore films, track favorites, and get personalized recommendations with search, genre filtering, and watchlists.
longDescription: Watch Wise is a full-stack movie discovery app built with Flutter/Dart on mobile and Node.js/Express/SQL on the backend. It integrates with the TMDB API to fetch real-time movie data and provides a seamless user experience with search, genre filtering, watchlists, and trending movies. Offline storage is handled via Hive, making the app fast and reliable even without connectivity.
challenges: Integrating TMDB API with a custom backend, managing offline-first state with Hive, and delivering smooth navigation across a Flutter multi-screen app.

title: Members & Attendance Dashboard
description: A full-stack admin dashboard for managing organization members, tracking attendance, and performing secure CRUD operations with JWT authentication.
longDescription: A Full Stack Web Application built with Node.js (Express) for the backend, React.js for the frontend, and SQL for the database. It helps admins manage organization members, track attendance, and perform CRUD operations securely using token-based authentication (JWT). The system features role-based access, ensuring only authorized admins can create, update, or delete data, while regular users can only view limited information.
challenges: Designing a secure role-based system where authorization rules are enforced on both frontend and backend, and keeping session state consistent across page refreshes.

title: Investment Calculator
description: A React app that projects future investment value year-by-year based on initial investment, annual contribution, return rate, and duration.
longDescription: A user-friendly React app that helps users project the future value of their investments. By entering the initial investment, annual contribution, expected return rate, and duration, users get a year-by-year breakdown of investment value, total interest earned, and capital invested. Ideal for visualizing compound growth over time.
challenges: Accurately computing compound growth formulas and presenting the results in a readable, year-by-year table format.

title: Time Challenge
description: A fast-paced React game that challenges your sense of timing—start a countdown and stop it as close to zero as possible with no visual hints.
longDescription: A fast-paced React time estimation game that challenges your sense of timing! Choose a difficulty level (1 to 15 seconds), start the countdown, and try to stop the timer as close as possible to zero—without any visual hints. Can you beat the clock using only your instincts? Test your timing skills across multiple levels and track your accuracy!
challenges: Implementing precise timer logic using React refs and hooks to avoid stale closures, and scoring the player's accuracy consistently.

title: Project Manager
description: A React app for managing multiple projects, each with its own task list—create, view, add, and delete tasks across unlimited projects.
longDescription: A user-friendly React application designed to help you manage multiple projects with ease. Create, view, and organize unlimited projects, each with its own set of tasks. Add or delete tasks within any project, keeping your workflow clean and efficient. Data persists via Local Storage so your projects survive page refreshes.
challenges: Structuring nested state for multiple projects each with their own task arrays, and persisting it reliably to Local Storage without stale data bugs.

title: Clothes E-Commerce
description: A sleek React shopping cart app for fashion with product browsing, cart management using Context and useReducer.
longDescription: A sleek and responsive React-based shopping cart application designed for fashion enthusiasts. Browse a curated collection of elegant clothing, view product details, and manage your cart seamlessly. Add or remove items with ease while enjoying a smooth and user-friendly shopping experience. Cart state is managed globally using React Context and useReducer.
features: Global cart state with Context + useReducer
challenges: Designing a scalable global state architecture using Context and useReducer that avoids unnecessary re-renders across the component tree.

title: Quiz App
description: A lightweight React quiz app testing knowledge of React.js and web development with multiple-choice questions and instant interaction.
longDescription: A lightweight React-based quiz application that tests users' knowledge of React.js and web development concepts. Featuring multiple-choice questions, instant interaction, and a clean interface, it's perfect for quick learning and self-assessment.
features: React and web development topic coverage
challenges: Managing question state and answer selection logic cleanly, and providing immediate visual feedback without revealing the correct answer prematurely.

title: PlacePicker
description: A React app that lets you build a personalized collection of places sorted by proximity to your current location, stored in a backend.
longDescription: A beautifully designed React app that lets you create a personalized collection of places you've visited or dream of exploring, stored in a backend. Places are automatically sorted based on your current location from nearest to farthest, making it easy to plan your next adventure. Discover, save, and visualize your travel inspirations in one elegant interface. Requires running the backend locally to function correctly.
features: Custom React hooks for data fetching
challenges: Integrating the browser Geolocation API with a backend sorting mechanism, and abstracting data-fetching logic into clean custom hooks.

title: Memory Game
description: A React card-flipping memory game where players find matching emoji pairs and track their best score.
longDescription: A playful React-based memory game where players flip cards to find matching pairs. Each round challenges your focus and recall abilities with fun emojis and a clean, interactive layout. The deck is shuffled using a randomization algorithm each round. Perfect for all ages—just flip, match, and try to beat your best score!
challenges: Implementing a reliable card shuffle algorithm and preventing the player from clicking more than two cards simultaneously during a match attempt.

title: Tic Tac Toe (React)
description: A React Tic Tac Toe game where players enter their names before playing with a clean UI and smooth gameplay.
longDescription: A fun and interactive Tic Tac Toe game built with React. Players can enter their names before starting, making each match more engaging. With a clean UI and smooth gameplay, it's perfect for quick competitive fun between friends. Win detection and draw conditions are handled automatically.
features: Player name input before game start
challenges: Computing win conditions across all board configurations efficiently and displaying the winning cells with clear visual feedback.

title: Book Library
description: A modern responsive book library interface with browsing, personal list management, author exploration, and dynamic search.
longDescription: A modern and responsive book library interface built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This app allows users to browse a collection of popular books, add titles to their personal list, explore trending authors, and view featured blog posts. Includes dynamic search functionality, interactive UI elements, and clean categorization for an engaging reading experience.
challenges: Building dynamic search and list management using vanilla JavaScript without any framework, maintaining clean DOM manipulation patterns.

title: React Demo
description: A foundational React app demonstrating core concepts: components, props, state management, and event handling.
longDescription: A simple React application demonstrating core concepts such as components, props, state management, and event handling. This demo serves as a foundational example for beginners looking to understand the essentials of building applications with React.js.
challenges: Organizing a clean, illustrative codebase that clearly demonstrates each React concept without overcomplicating the examples.

title: Tic Tac Toe (Vanilla JS)
description: A classic two-player Tic Tac Toe game built with vanilla JavaScript featuring name input and score tracking across rounds.
longDescription: A classic two-player Tic Tac Toe game built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Players can enter their names, take turns making moves, and track scores across multiple rounds.
challenges: Implementing clean win-detection logic and score persistence across rounds using only vanilla JavaScript.

title: EasyBank Landing Page
description: A fully responsive landing page for a fictional digital banking service with interactive navigation, feature highlights, and article previews.
longDescription: A fully responsive landing page built with HTML and CSS for a fictional digital banking service. The design highlights Easybank's features like online banking, budgeting, onboarding, and Open API. Includes interactive navigation, article previews, and a clean call-to-action for inviting users.
challenges: Achieving pixel-perfect responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints using only HTML and CSS without any framework.

title: LoopStudios Landing Page
description: A sleek responsive landing page for a virtual reality company showcasing immersive VR creations with a modern layout.
longDescription: A sleek and fully responsive landing page built with HTML and CSS, highlighting a virtual reality company's portfolio. Featuring immersive visuals, clean layout, and a modern design, this page showcases LoopStudios' cutting-edge VR creations and company story.
challenges: Creating an immersive visual layout that conveys the VR brand identity using only CSS, without JavaScript or design frameworks.

title: Vacation Trips
description: A Flutter app for exploring vacation destinations with list/grid views and detailed location information for travel lovers.
longDescription: Vacation Trip App is a Flutter-based mobile application designed to help users explore beautiful destinations, plan trips, and view detailed information about various vacation spots. With a simple interface, users can browse places in list or grid view and dive into each location's details—perfect for travel lovers and adventure seekers.
features: Destination browsing in list and grid views
challenges: Designing a flexible layout that looks great in both list and grid view modes, and managing navigation state across multiple screens cleanly.

title: BMI Calculator
description: A Flutter BMI Calculator app where users select gender, adjust height, weight, and age to calculate their Body Mass Index and health category.
longDescription: A simple and responsive BMI Calculator app built with Flutter. Users can select gender, adjust height, weight, and age using interactive sliders, then calculate and view their Body Mass Index along with a health category label (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese).
challenges: Building an accurate BMI formula implementation and displaying results with meaningful health category labels and color coding.

title: Cafe Sales Dashboard
description: An interactive Excel dashboard visualizing coffee sales performance with dynamic charts, slicers, and monthly trend analysis.
longDescription: An interactive Excel dashboard that visualizes coffee sales performance, including total revenue, cups sold, and best-selling coffee types. The project features dynamic charts and slicers for filtering by coffee type and size, along with trend analysis for monthly sales and revenue distribution.
features: Total revenue and cups sold KPIs
Dynamic slicers by type and size
challenges: Automating data transformation and slicer interactions with Power Query and Visual Basic to make the dashboard fully dynamic without manual refresh steps.

title: Brazilian E-Commerce Analysis
description: A Power BI analysis of the Brazilian Olist e-commerce dataset with data modeling, DAX calculations, and rich sales visualizations.
longDescription: A Power BI analysis of the Brazilian E-Commerce public dataset (Olist), including sales performance by product, category, and customer demographics. Utilizes Power BI features such as data modeling, DAX calculations, and visualizations to extract insights and trends from the e-commerce data.
features: Sales performance by product and category
challenges: Building an efficient star-schema data model from the raw Olist relational tables and writing accurate DAX measures for time-intelligence calculations.

title: Cairo Metro Data Intelligence
description: A Python data analysis project providing deep insights into Cairo's metro system covering passenger trends, revenue, station performance, and interactive Folium maps.
longDescription: The Cairo Metro Data Analysis & Visualization project provides deep insights into Cairo's metro system using Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Folium. It analyzes passenger trends, revenue patterns, station performance, and service reliability through clear visualizations and interactive maps. The project highlights time-based passenger behaviors, identifies crowded and high-performing stations, and tracks service issues over time. An interactive Folium map displays stations, lines, and performance metrics for better spatial understanding.
features: Interactive Folium map with metro lines
challenges: Cleaning and structuring raw metro operational data for analysis, and rendering interactive geographic visualizations with Folium in a Jupyter Notebook environment.

title: SuperStore Sales Dashboard
description: An interactive Excel dashboard tracking SuperStore sales from 2015–2018 with revenue, orders, and customer insights by category, region, and sub-category.
longDescription: An interactive Excel dashboard visualizing sales performance from 2015 to 2018, tracking revenue, orders, and customer insights. Includes detailed analysis by category, region, and sub-category, highlighting top-performing states, customers, and monthly sales trends. Built with Power Query for data transformation and Power Pivot for advanced calculations.
challenges: Integrating Power Query for ETL and Power Pivot for a data model that supports cross-table calculations across a 4-year dataset.

title: Titanic Survival Analysis
description: A Python analysis of Titanic passenger data uncovering survival patterns by class, gender, and age with Pandas and Matplotlib/Seaborn visualizations.
longDescription: A Python analysis of Titanic passenger data, including survival rates by class, gender, and age. Utilizes Pandas for data manipulation and Matplotlib/Seaborn for visualizations to uncover patterns and insights about the tragic event. Includes data cleaning, feature exploration, and correlation analysis.
features: Survival rate by class, gender, and age
Data cleaning and missing value handling
challenges: Handling missing values in the age and cabin columns appropriately, and choosing the right chart types to tell a clear story from the data.

title: Chinook Database Analysis
description: A SQL analysis of the Chinook music store database extracting sales insights by artist, album, and customer demographics using complex queries.
longDescription: A SQL analysis of the Chinook database, including sales performance by artist, album, and customer demographics. Utilizes complex SQL queries—including joins, subqueries, window functions, and aggregations—to extract insights and trends from the music store data. Executed in a Jupyter Notebook environment with Python for result visualization.
challenges: Writing efficient multi-join SQL queries against a normalized relational schema, and presenting results clearly through Python visualizations in Jupyter.

title: C. Ronaldo Goals Dashboard
description: An interactive Excel dashboard visualizing Cristiano Ronaldo's goals and assists with dynamic slicers by season and competition.
longDescription: An interactive Excel dashboard that visualizes Cristiano Ronaldo's goals performance, including total goals, assists, and best matches. The project features dynamic charts and slicers for filtering by season and competition, along with trend analysis for monthly goals and assists distribution.
challenges: Structuring the raw goals dataset with Power Query to support multi-dimensional filtering by season, competition, and match type simultaneously.
